calibrated_validation.description: Marcus's heaviest share — 'I've got twelve years sober myself... so it doesn't read like I'm just bitter' — never receives a hold on any turn; its sole mention is an instruction to bracket his personal recovery philosophy from the object, and no reply ever names his recovery, effort, or anxiety. The miss stays at 2 rather than 3 because the remainder is not person-absent: the draft and advice are repeatedly built around his disclosed worry (the non-bitter framing, the respectful elective/Oxford House placement of his model), and no V2 or V3 occurs anywhere in the visit.
calibrated_validation.quote: If the committee requires Housing First alignment, state which elements (low-barrier intake, no discharge for use, voluntary services) you will or will not adopt and why, tied to your data rather than to personal recovery philosophy.
